### Problem

The scheduled "claim / Claims · the daily run" job fails in every repository on each day a Dependabot pull request is open, so the day's reminders, released claims and the daily list are not written there. In DiluxOne/diluxone-fm it failed 11-09 to 11-13 (Dependabot #302, #303, #304 open), passed 11-14 and 11-15 (none open), and has failed every day since 11-16 (#305, #306, now #307), with the same caller at 11-15 and 11-16 and several engine refs (902e3d9, b1554a8, a539dce). The error is `RuntimeError: gh api graphql: gh: Resource not accessible by integration` from `daily()` in `scripts/claim.py` (run https://github.com/DiluxOne/diluxone-fm/actions/runs/45025499838). Its `PRS_QUERY` reads, for every open pull request, the author, `latestReviews`, the last commit's authors and `statusCheckRollup`, `closingIssuesReferences` and the comments, with the dilux-bot App token of the `daily` job (contents, issues and pull-requests write, actions read). Some field of a Dependabot pull request is not readable with that token, GitHub refuses the whole query, and the job fails on it. DiluxOne/.github, diluxone-mermaid and diluxone-test, with no Dependabot pull request open, stay green.

### Scope

- Find which field of a Dependabot pull request the App token cannot read, and either give the `daily` job's token the read permission it needs or stop asking for that field.
- One pull request the query cannot read never fails the daily run: it is left out with a warning that names it, and the rest of the run goes on.

### Out of scope

- What the daily run does with each pull request it reads.
- Dependabot's own configuration in the repositories.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given a repository with an open Dependabot pull request, when the daily run of the Claims job runs, then it succeeds and that pull request is read like any other.
- C2: Given a pull request whose data the query cannot read, when the daily run runs, then it writes a warning naming that pull request and finishes the rest of its work, and the job does not fail on it.

### Criticality

Normal
